account away-and-back during deferred final simulation keeps the cancelled review invalid and enters wallet send zero times
a foreign connected wallet cannot prepare deployment or send an upgrade
owner connects and reviews exact package, roles, proxy and fee quote without automatic wallet writes

account change during deferred final simulation sends zero transactions

independentLifecycleRegression.scenario: During deferred final simulation, switch away from Base, allow the active review to clear, then return to Base before releasing the simulation.

confirmedSafeguards: The fetched public package is raw-SHA-pinned, and the local validator binds exact baseline/candidate source and bytecode hashes, storage shape, profile, immutable spans, capabilities and fixed dependencies.
Candidate runtime patches only its two compiler __self spans with the actual deployment receipt address and checks full code, UUPS UUID, MAX_OPEN_PACKS10 and PERMIT_OPEN_VERSION1.

Deploy and upgrade remain two distinct explicit owner reviews. Final active-review identity, expiry, mounted state and current wallet are checked synchronously after the last await and directly before wallet entry.
Successful deployment and upgrade receipts must match transaction hash, mined block, owner, value, exact creation or upgrade calldata and actual deployed address.

Pending or ambiguous saved hashes block another submission; repriced hashes are persisted and unrelated replacements remain blocked. Only explicit canonical cancelled/reverted receipt resolution clears an owned pending hash.
The proxy upgrade uses empty initialization bytes, preserves existing singles/batches and source/storage dependencies, and does not buy or open packs.
limitations: The independent review ran offline builder/helper tests and one actual-page browser regression using intercepted synthetic wallet/RPC responses. The full 15-group owner browser run was inspected author evidence, not an additional independent full rerun.
No production provider, owner wallet, signing key or mainnet transaction was used. Actual installation and post-installation checks remain owner actions.
Standalone compiler reproduction was inspected as separate author evidence; this review did not rerun the compiler.
The package tests used the existing retained out-batch and out-permit artifacts. No fresh-checkout bootstrap was executed; their full frozen source/compiler inputs remain public.
